styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Palaces, hanok lanes and the city's best museums.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Markets, BBQ and all-night street snacks.

styles.label: Shopping
styles.blurb: Myeongdong cosmetics, Dongdaemun and Gangnam malls.

stays.why: Walk to the shopping streets, Namsan and the subway hub at Myeongdong station. Easiest base for first-timers.
Next to Gyeongbokgung, Bukchon hanok lanes and Insadong. Quiet at night, central for sightseeing.
Modern hotels, big malls and nightlife. Good for business trips; longer rides to the old palaces.
Cheapest of the four, young and lively, close to the airport rail link. Noisy on weekend nights.

food.tip: Eat at Gwangjang Market: bindaetteok (mung-bean pancakes), mayak gimbap and knife-cut noodles. Expect roughly ₩5,000–12,000 a plate.
Korean BBQ is a group meal. Order pork belly or beef, wrap it in lettuce with garlic; expect ₩15,000–30,000 per person.
Street snacks in Myeongdong and Hongdae: tteokbokki, hotteok and fried chicken. Most items cost ₩3,000–8,000.
Cheap and filling: gimbap shops and university-area restaurants serve a full meal for about ₩6,000–10,000.
Many restaurants are open late. Look for 24-hour spots around markets and Hongdae; check on the day for closing times.

more_time.swap: Add a day trip to Suwon Hwaseong Fortress or the DMZ tour; both need a full day, book ahead.
Swap one shopping afternoon for a Han River picnic and a bike rental at Yeouido.
Spend a morning in a jjimjilbang (Korean spa) or a palace hanbok rental instead of another museum.

recommend.why: Three nights covers the palaces, markets and shopping without rushing; spring and autumn are the best months.

month_notes: Coldest month: highs near 2°C, lows around -7°C. Pack a heavy coat; few rainy days.
Still cold, highs near 5°C. Indoor sights and cafés are comfortable.
Warming up to about 12°C. Cherry blossoms usually appear late in the month; check on the day.
Pleasant spring: highs near 18°C, some rain. Great for walking the palaces.
One of the best months: warm, around 23°C, with a few wet days.
Warm and humid, highs near 27°C. Rain picks up late in the month.
Rainy season: about 18 rain days and highs near 29°C. Carry an umbrella daily.
Hot and wet, similar to July. Plan indoor breaks in the afternoon.
Cooling to about 25°C and drier. Excellent for sightseeing.
Best month: clear, mild, highs near 19°C. Autumn leaves peak late in the month.
Turning cold, highs near 11°C. Light layers plus a jacket.
Cold again: highs near 3°C, lows around -5°C. Few rain days; dress warmly.

climate_guide.summary: Four clear seasons: cold, dry winters and hot, rainy summers. Spring and autumn are the best times to visit.

items.title: Best time: April to May and September to October
items.text: Mild highs of 18–25°C with fewer rainy days. Ideal for palaces, walking and markets.

items.title: Winter is cold and dry
items.text: January highs near 2°C and lows around -7°C, with only about 3 rain days. Bring a heavy coat.

items.title: Rainy season in July and August
items.text: About 18 and 16 rain days, with highs near 29°C. Expect heavy downpours; carry an umbrella.

items.title: Hot, humid summer
items.text: June to August feels muggy. Plan outdoor sights for morning and rest indoors in the afternoon.

items.title: Crisp autumn
items.text: September and October cool to 19–25°C with fewer wet days. The most comfortable months.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Layers for spring and autumn, a warm coat for winter, and a rain jacket or umbrella for summer.

transit.best: Get a T-money card and use the metro for most trips; buses beat traffic on short hops.

modes.text: 9 numbered lines plus suburban lines. Base fare ₩1,550 with card, ₩1,650 single ticket. Stops late at night.
Buses have their own lanes and beat traffic. Use a T-money card for both bus and metro.
Metered and plentiful. Kakao T is the main ride-hailing app; Uber works too.
Possible but traffic jams are common and parking is costly. Not needed for most trips.
Good in Myeongdong, Jongno and Hongdae. Use metro for longer hops between districts.
Unlimited 1–7 day transit passes from ₩5,000 to ₩20,000. Good value if you ride often.
Subway stops late at night; night buses run on major routes.
